canonical_statement: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y between smooth quasi-projective schemes and a vector bundle E on X, the Chern character of the K-theoretic proper pushforward, multiplied by the Todd class of Y, equals the Chow-theoretic proper pushforward of the Chern character of E multiplied by the Todd class of X.
domains_and_universes: Provisional: schemes X and Y over a fixed base field, a proper morphism f : X -> Y, smooth/quasi-projective hypotheses, and a vector bundle E on X; Lean universes not yet frozen
hypotheses: X and Y are smooth quasi-projective over k
E is a vector bundle on X
conclusion: ch(f_! E) * td(T_Y) = f_*(ch(E) * td(T_X)) in the rational Chow ring/group of Y

alternate_encodings.target: tau_X : G_0(X) -> A_*(X)_Q natural for proper morphisms

alternate_encodings.relationship: relative-Todd reformulation when tangent-class identities and projection formula apply

analytic or differential-geometric index theorem alone
